items.title: 'Confusopoly' blamed as power bill changes surprise customers
items.description: Some electricity users have been hit with higher charges, despite all the talk of the lower default market offers. Retailers say a rebalancing of supply and usage charges is the cause, but there are signs some are clawing back profit by raising their cheapest plans.

items.title: Self-managed super sector blindsided by Labor–Greens deal on tax package
items.description: A ban on self-managed super funds borrowing money to buy housing has blindsided the sector, which says Labor should instead target "unscrupulous" operators spruiking property as an investment.

items.title: Live: Minister says Australian housing market experiencing a correction
items.description: Housing Minister Clare O'Neil says Australia's housing market is experiencing a correction following COVID amid low auction clearance rates in major capital cities. Follow live.

items.title: 'I love you': Sydney shark attack survivor's first words to family
items.description: A Sydney mother mauled by a shark at Coogee Beach almost a fortnight ago has spoken her first words after briefly waking from an induced coma.

items.title: US Senate calls for Trump to end Iran war in bipartisan vote
items.description: It is the 10th time the Senate has tried to stop the war, and the outcome, on a vote of 50–48, is a stunning turnaround from past efforts.

items.title: Live: England frustrated by resolute Ghana, Ronaldo makes a statement
items.description: England is held to a frustrating 0-0 draw by a resolute Ghana after Cristiano Ronaldo scored twice in a 5-0 Portugal win over Uzbekistan. Follow live.

items.title: Major construction company hit by alleged multi-million-dollar insider fraud
items.description: Queensland police have uncovered an alleged industrial espionage operation that caused major construction company Shadforth's confidential data to be leaked to competitors.

items.title: Experts ask why triple murderer was granted bail before deadly spree
items.description: Sophie Quinn sought police protection from her former partner. Less than two months later he murdered her and two others during a shooting spree at Lake Cargelligo.

items.title: Outgoing British PM holds secret meeting with likely successor
items.description: Sir Keir Starmer and the man who has essentially forced him to resign as prime minister, Andy Burnham, have held their first face-to-face meeting.

items.title: Port Moresby's water supply network showing 'signs of imminent failure'
items.description: A decades-old pipeline supplying water to nearly 1 million people in Papua New Guinea's capital is at risk of collapsing without urgent repairs, threatening to cut off more than half of the city's water supply.

items.title: IVF add-ons are common in Australia, but there's no proof most work
items.description: Experts urge clinics and specialists to "carefully consider" offering IVF add-on treatments as they can be seen as "implicit endorsement of benefit" when there's little evidence most work.

items.title: 'Punched in the guts': Sacked academics take uni to Fair Work Commission
items.description: Two senior academics from Macquarie University allege they were targeted for redundancy because of their union activity.

items.title: Australians financially supporting family in Lebanon say they have no other option
items.description: Lebanese Australians, who have spent thousands of dollars to help their loved ones survive a two-and-a-half-year war, bear a financial burden that also comes with an emotional toll.

items.title: Live: ASX to rise ahead of inflation figures, despite Wall Street's tech sell-off
items.description: The Australian share market is expected to rise despite a major sell-off across US tech, AI and semiconductor stocks, which resulted in steep losses on Wall Street. The ABS will release its May inflation data, which will be impacted by sharp falls in petrol and diesel prices. Follow live.

items.title: Gardening Australia star discovered plants unknown to science but couldn't be his true self
items.description: Gardening Australia star Jerry Coleby-Williams hid his identity on TV for 26 years, but has never been ashamed of being a gay man.

items.title: Quiz: Join us for a mid-week trip around the world
items.description: Which town would you be in if you were sunbathing at Cable Beach? Where does Maldon sea salt come from?

items.title: Cheap and easy ways to heat the human instead of the home
items.description: Heating your whole house — or even a room — can be expensive in the depths of winter. Keeping the humans inside it warm is often cheaper and more efficient.

items.title: The 'uncontrolled' police department behind fatal shooting of Perth girl
items.description: The grandfather of Australian schoolgirl Hania Ahmed recounts the aftermath of her fatal shooting, as a senior Pakistani lawyer takes aim at the "uncontrolled" police department at the centre of her death.

items.title: UN inquiry accuses Israel of deliberately targeting and killing Palestinian children
items.description: The Israeli government is condemning the inquiry and rejecting its findings, labelling the United Nations report "deeply flawed" and full of "errors and distortions" designed to push a "politically driven anti-Israel narrative".

items.title: Australia launches world-first suicide prevention approach
items.description: Policymakers, mental health experts and those working on the front line will use the National Suicide Prevention Outcomes Map to gauge what services are working to prevent people from reaching critical crisis points.

items.title: Accused of misconduct and cleared, ex-CEO wins vindication and $2.3 million
items.description: Once a promising space start-up chief executive, Carley Scott was terminated from her job and left millions out of pocket. Now she's finally found vindication, with a court ruling in her favour.

items.title: At least 40 drownings reported in France as Europe swelters
items.description: Schools are being ordered to close in the UK and railways are urging against non-essential travel across the continent as record-breaking heat takes hold.

items.title: 'I get a lot of anxiety': Borrowers caught out with high-interest car loans
items.description: A new report warns customers about traps they face when taking out a car loan, including high-interest rates and fees.

items.title: Five key takeaways from Crisafulli's second budget
items.description: This year's Queensland budget includes no "sugar hits" when it comes to cost of living, a big interest repayment bill and plenty of construction projects in the pipeline.

items.title: Budget offers short-term sugar hit but there could be bitterness to come
items.description: Faced with rising interest rates, high grocery prices and bloated bills, the cost-of-living help announced in Tuesday's budget will only make a minor dent in household budgets, Nick Dole writes.
